Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City s. 2010 HON. PAYAPA V. ONA http: //www.dilg.com.ph OP!NiON NO. g__ 14 OCT 2019 Sangguniang Panlalawigan Members Malabon City Dear SP Member Ona: This is in reference to your letter dated 20 July 2019, requesting the Department to render legal opinion on the following queries: ii. What faction should be recognized as the legitimate minority bloc of the 7th Sangguniang Panlungsod of Malabon, should it be the three undersigned (SP Members Ona, Vicencio and Nolasco) from the Nacionalista Party and member of the local political faction "Team Kakampi" or Councilor Jose Lorenzon Oreta member of the local political coalition Team Pamilyang Malabonian and Councilor Diosdado Cunanan who run as individual (independent) candidate but also belongs to the National Unity Party, an affiliate of the majority bloc/coalition Team Pamilyang Malabonian? Whether the disapproval last July 8, 2019 of the PROPOSED RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE HONORABLE CITY COUNCILOR PA YAPA VIOLA-ONA AS THE MINORITY FLOOR LEADER OF THE 7TH SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF MALABON and the approval last July 15, 2019 of the RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE HONORABLE CITY COUNCILOR DIOSDADO A. CUNANAN AS THE MINORITY FLOOR LEADER OF THE 7TH SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF MALABON null and void due to the meddling of the majority bloc? The legislative process to be observed by the sanggunian are found in Sections 48-59 of the Local Government Code. Under Section 50 of the same Code, the sanggunian is given the authority to promulgate its own Internal Rules of Procedure. Accordingly, the conduct of the internal affairs of the sanggunian should be done in accordance with law, primarily, and by the adopted Internal Rules, if the law is silent. Since it is clear that the herein queries cannot be dealt with by Sections 48- 59 of the Code, it shall be governed by the Internal Rules Procedure (IRP) of that sanggunian, specifically, Article II, Rule IV of City Resolution No. AOI-2019, entitled "A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE INTERNAL RULES OF PROCEDURE OF THE 5TH SANGGUNIANG PANLIJNGSOD OF MALABON", which states that:

"The Minority Floor Leader. There shall be one (1) Minority Floor Leader who shall be chosen among the "minority" party or faction in the Sangguniang Panlungsod and presented to the body during the Session by formal resolution sponsored by most members of the "minority" and whose duties are as follows.xxx" In DILG Opinion No. 30, s. 19991, the Department had the occasion to differentiate "majority" from "minority" citing the case of Santiago and Tatad vs. Guingona and Fernan2. Where, majority in either House of Congress has referred to the political party to which the most number of lawmakers belonged while the "minority" normally referred to a political party with a lesser number of members. Based on the definition of "minority" cited above that the same refers to a political party with a lesser number of lawmakers belonged, we are of the view that SP Members Jose Lorenzo Oreta and Diosdado Cunanan's contention that the determination of the minority floor leader is based on the lesser number of party member or faction is not contrary to Article II, Rule IV of City Resolution No. A02- 2019. As a matter of fact, this is precisely the interpretation made in the case of Santiago and Tatad vs. Guingona and Fernan. We beg to disagree with your interpretation that SP Members Oreta and Cunanan belongs to the majority as the National Unity Party where they belong is an affiliate of the coalition Team Pamilyang Malabonian, a majority bloc. The basis of determining the minority and majority in the sanggunian should be the number of elected officials from a political party. Accordingly, this Department shall not disturb the disapproval of the PROPOSED RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE HONORABLE CITY COUNCILOR PAYAPA VIOLA-ONA AS THE MINORITY FLOOR LEADER OF THE 7TH SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF MALABON, as well as, the approval of the RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE HONORABLE CITY COUNCILOR DIOSDADO A. CUNANAN AS THE MINORITY FLOOR LEADER OF THE 7TH SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF MALABON as the said acts are clearly matters pertaining exclusively to the domain of and within the prerogative of the sanggunian concerned. CC: We hope we have assisted you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: MARI L C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary Dir.
